note: The shade audit's 'Add first' table (docs/plant-data/shade-audit.md): the staples the Shade Perennials tab had no genus of. Natives read against the Wildflower Center and New Moon or the Missouri Botanical Garden Plant Finder; the rest against the Plant Finder. Where sources disagree, estimates says which value was taken and why.

note2: The audit's 'Worth adding next' list (batch add-next): natives read against the Wildflower Center and the Missouri Botanical Garden Plant Finder, with New Moon, NC State, Fine Gardening, Oregon State and the University of Washington where the Plant Finder had no page; the rest against the Plant Finder, Walters Gardens, Lurie Garden and the RHS. Yellow archangel and creeping Jenny were left out: both are invasive in parts of North America, and Wisconsin's NR 40 exempts only the gold-leaved creeping Jenny everybody sells, which a species caution cannot say.
